title: Claude extension inbound line
description: One line of .devcontainer/tmp/logs/claude-code-vscode-ext-inbound.jsonl, appended by the patched Claude Code extension (user-action-observer.py) for every webview -> extension message. A line without `v` is today's format; `v` is 1 when present. The file is wiped at container start.

sessionId.description: Claude Code session id when the message carries or implies one, else null.

channelId.description: Webview channel id, or the request id for request-shaped messages.

pid.description: Claude process pid when the observer could find it.

type.description: The message type. Known: io_message, response, request, launch_claude, interrupt_claude, close_channel, cancel_request. Consumers ignore unknown types.

payload.description: The webview message verbatim. Consumers read payload.response.type / payload.response.result.behavior (response), payload.message.type (io_message), payload.resume (launch_claude).
